nodes.definition: This Class contains Spinach (Spinacia oleracea), an edible flowering plant in the family of Amaranthaceae. While native to central and south western Asia, it is commonly grown through out the world. It grows to a height of up to 30 cm long and 1-15 cm broad, with larger leaves at the base of the plant and small leaves higher on the flowering stem. Spinach has a high nutritional value and is extremely rich in antioxidants, especially when fresh, steamed, or quickly boiled. It is rich in vitamins.

nodes.definition: An Utility Task Vehicle (UTV) or Recreational Off-Road Vehicle (ROV) is a vehicle that travels on low-pressure tires, with side by side seating for the driver and passengers. Many have safety features such as seat belts and roll over protection and most have a cargo area for haulage. UTVs are designed as a vehicle which can handle any variety of terrain while carrying equipment and/or materials to perform a job or task. While they might be "street-legal", they have been designed for off-road task applications as a core. Includes all products (e.g. military, emergency service, industrial or other special specifications) which fit the product definition.
